extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: stylized norway spruce, approx. 3.5 m wide, 7.8 m tall
extras.notes: trunk base at origin; slim dense cone of nine stacked needle tiers with many drooping branch tips, soft hanging twig tassels in a lighter green, hanging cones in the upper third and a slender leader shoot; narrower and denser than the pine tree, no alpha cards

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
